name: C++ II — Object-Oriented Programming & Templates
description: Master classes, constructors, inheritance, virtual polymorphism, generic templates, STL containers, and build a Bank Management System.
whatYouLearn: Build C++ classes with constructors and RAII destructors
Implement virtual polymorphism and abstract interfaces
Write generic code using C++ Templates
Build a Bank Management System Capstone
